axes.source_G: R3 fault-bit index with R7/3 offset

tables.static_evidence: All six ROMs share startup instructions at 0CB5h..0CBEh: 0CB7h reads XRAM F847h and 0CBAh/0CBEh copy its bits 0/1 to IRAM27h bits 1/3. The G traced branch seeds F847h=80h at 0C85h before this read; persistence across starts is unproven. All six seed F83Bh=32h at 0CABh..0CAFh and use identical countdown opcodes at G/S88 2C0Ch or A-family 2C28h. G/S88 2D21h..2D56h copies fault bits back to F847h; the A-family homologue is 2D3Dh..2D72h. G/S88 407Dh mask IRAM27h with XRAM F884h and 41E5h write active bits to F84Eh; A-family homologues are 413Ah and 42A2h. G/S88 2B42h/2B49h set bits 1/3, versus 2B5Eh/2B65h in A-family. For bit 0, G/S88 29CBh..29D6h and A-family 29E7h..29F2h require IRAM70h>4Ah and XRAM F83Ch=0 before SETB 27h.0. All six ROMs have identical twelve record bytes; isolated original-opcode tests confirm the F839h bit patterns and the bit-0 threshold in all six.
tables.dynamic_evidence: G original 1000-RPM trace with ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=40/40/63 sets IRAM27h bits 1/3 at 2B42h/2B49h near tick 1.239M, saves F847h=0xC7 at 2D56h and publishes F84Eh=0Eh at 41E5h near tick 1.387M; ADC0/6=120/180 publishes only F84Eh=04h in 2.4M ticks. Experimentally forcing P4.6 low with ADC0/6=40/95 leaves F839h=0Fh, skips 2B38h, and uses 2C0Ch for bit 3. F83Bh starts at 32h, counts down to zero at tick 664994, then 2C0Ch leaves bit 3 set, 2D56h saves F847h=C6h, and 41E5h publishes F84Eh=08h. These are diagnostic bits, not proof of a transmitted K-Line record or physical fault.
tables.bit0_dynamic_evidence: With experimental P4.6-low, G 1000-RPM TPS40/95 and TPS120/180 boots execute 29D0h but not 29D2h. IRAM70h settles at 1Bh and 37h from 11D1h; both fail the >4Ah guard. At TPS40/220, both P4.6 states calculate IRAM6Fh=1Bh at 11B6h and IRAM70h=53h at 11C0h. P4.6 high executes 29F5h and publishes F84Eh=04h. Experimental P4.6 low executes 29D5h (IRAM27h=08h->09h at tick 1187188) and publishes F84Eh=01h at 41E5h by tick 1384046. A complete PTY session with these low-P4.6 inputs reaches 4329h and 4DFBh and receives FC payload 02 04 1D; MA17_EXPECT_FAULT_TRIPLET=02041D passes. The six-ROM isolated original-opcode test reaches SETB 27h.0 only for IRAM70h=4Bh and XRAM F83Ch=0. This confirms the digital source, latch and emulated K-Line frame, not the physical input wiring.
tables.bit0_formula_evidence: ROM[11A8h..11D4h] is byte-identical in all six images. The isolated original-opcode test confirms the alternative branch writes IRAM6Fh=max(0,min(FFh,R2+0Dh)-R3) and IRAM70h=min(FFh,IRAM6Fh+38h), including floor and saturation cases. Normal-branch selection in other hardware revisions is unverified.

tables.consumer: G MOVC 0C8Ah with DPTR=7300h and A=0
tables.output: MOVX 0C8Dh writes 07h to XRAM F83Dh in the tested P2=F8h startup state
tables.static_evidence: G 0C86h..0C8Dh reads offset zero of 7300h then writes @R0 with R0=3Dh; all six ROMs retain byte 07h at 7300h. G 2378h reads F83Dh into R4; branches 23CEh..2490h can change R4 before 2494h writes it back. Other literal-base conditional writers are 2258h, 22EFh and 281Fh; computed addresses remain possible.

Experimental P4.7-low at two TPS states likewise leaves 07h. Changing only R4 at 23B1h to 05h or 09h made original instructions at 2494h write F83Dh 07h->06h or 07h->08h. This is a digital counterfactual; physical meaning remains a scanner hypothesis.

tables.consumer: G 461Ch loads R5=IRAM[62h], DPTR=7100h and calls 5313h/532Fh; A/S37 46D9h..46E8h calls 53D6h when 2Fh.5=0
tables.output: IRAM[7Ch] at G 4629h or A/S37 46E6h; G uses it at 14D9h before IRAM[48h] write at 1523h, then at 1E18h before CC3 scheduling
tables.static_evidence: G 461Ch uses direct DPTR=7100h; 532Fh/5333h read adjacent bytes with MOVC. A/S37 06D0h schedule table at 06E1h maps index 8 to ADC2/destination 62h and index 7 to ADC3/destination 63h; 0716h..0744h writes ADC2 result to lower 62h but redirects ADC3 to upper A8h
tables.dynamic_evidence: Corrected C517A ADDATL model, experiments_adc517a: ADC2 100->40 changes IRAM62h 64h->28h, moves MOVC pair 7103h/7104h to 7101h/7102h, IRAM7Ch 7Eh->76h, IRAM48h 40h->3Ch and CC3 scheduling median 1422->1336 in G and S88 at 1000 RPM/ADC7=63. In G, supplying original MOVC result+08h only for 7100h..7108h with ADC2=100 leaves ROM hash and IRAM62h unchanged while IRAM7Ch 7Eh->86h, IRAM48h 40h->44h, CC3 scheduling median 1422->1508 and modeled low width 5677->6021 ticks. Isolated A/S37 original-ROM code at 46D9h..46E8h yields IRAM7Ch=7Eh/76h for IRAM62h=64h/28h with 2Fh.5=0, or 80h with 2Fh.5=1. Isolated schedule and result paths at 06D0h and 0716h confirm ADC2 to lower 62h and ADC3 to upper A8h; full A/S37 boot and CC3 effects were not exercised
tables.temperature_grid_evidence: Corrected G/S88 2.4M-tick grid at 1000 RPM and ADC7=63, ADC3 fixed 80: ADC2=20/80/160/220 gives IRAM62h=14h/50h/A0h/DCh, IRAM7Ch=73h/7Ch/83h/8Eh, IRAM48h=3Ah/3Fh/42h/48h, CC3 scheduling medians=1304/1400/1495/1616 and modeled P1.3 low medians=5205/5589/5969/6453 ticks. P5.0 medians stay 1861 G and 1921 S88. Scanner Celsius conversion is an unvalidated analog hypothesis.
tables.transient_evidence: At 1000 RPM, ADC7=63, G and S88 ADC2 10-bit step 400->160 at tick 800000 changes IRAM62h 64h->28h at 807636 and IRAM48h 40h->3Ch at 816935/816950; CC3 scheduling 1440->1352->1336. G reverse step 160->400 restores IRAM62h/48h and CC3 1352->1440->1422. Modeled P1.3 low widths change G ~5749->5333, reverse ~5397->5677, S88 ~5749->5332 ticks. A constant-ADC2=400 G control also changes CC3 1440->1422 near tick 1087600 without any 62h change. All four runs show upper IRAM87h 1Ah->18h at PC155Bh near tick 1073000. Code reads 87h at 1562h, writes 59h:5Ah at 1644h/1646h, and reads the pair at 1D60h. G/S88 downward step changes 5Ah 5Ch->04h near tick 817000, then 59h:5Ah 05h:04h->04h:F4h near 1083260. The later CC3 change is not attributable solely to the ADC2 step; mediation by 87h and 59h:5Ah is supported by timing and code, pending isolation.
tables.post_decay_transient_evidence: With the same 1000 RPM/ADC7=63 state, moving the ADC2 step to tick 1200000 places it after upper IRAM87h decays 1Ah->18h near tick 1073000. G and S88 400->160 steps change IRAM62h 64h->28h at 1206996 and IRAM48h 40h->3Ch near 1216560; next CC3 scheduling directly changes 1422->1336 near tick 1236100 and modeled low width ~5677->5333. G reverse 160->400 directly changes CC3 1336->1422 and low width ~5333->5677. No intermediate 1352/1440 plateau occurs after this later step. These digital contrasts isolate ADC2 response from the observed 87h time-state change, without validating physical output identity.
tables.diagnostic_evidence: The fourth collection-table record at 6E7Eh is raw bytes 00 62 (IRAM 62h). On the same isolated A/S37 emulator state, original scheduler 06D0h selects ADC2, original result path 0716h..0744h writes the injected converted byte 64h to lower IRAM62h, then original collector 4F72h..4F89h copies 64h to XRAM F8BBh. The scanner labels this slot IAT; physical sensor identity and Celsius scale remain unverified.
tables.upper_ae_path_evidence: G 14D9h reads IRAM7Ch, 14F0h selects the shared 715Ah curve, and 14FDh writes upper IRAM AEh via @R0. At 1000 RPM and ADC0/6=40/95, ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, the optional pre-write probe found 95 occurrences of RAM7Ch/ACC=7Eh/21h. Supplying +08h only at 7100h MOVC reads changed those 95 occurrences to 86h/23h with the original G ROM and ADC2 fixed at 100; ADC2=200 gave 89h/24h. This establishes an emulated digital path to AEh, not the sensor's physical scale.
tables.upper_ae_segment_crossing: At 1000 RPM, ADC0/6=40/95 and ADC3/5/7=20/40/63, natural ADC2=4 yields upper AEh=1Dh at PC330Dh in 95 observations, a 7B46h-matrix lower-cell MOVC at 7B58h in 95 reads and R2=96h at PC3371h in 95 observations. ADC2=100 gives AEh=21h, no 7B58h reads and R2=97h in those 95 slots. With ADC2 held at 100, adding F2h modulo 256 only to 7100h MOVC returns exactly reproduces the AEh, matrix-cell and R2 distributions of ADC2=4. Final IRAM69h remains 9Ah in all three; physical ADC2 scale is unverified.

Trace A/S37 IRAM7Ch to CC3 under a validated hardware profile

tables.format: 9 raw u8 values, adjacent-pair interpolation
tables.consumer: G 3C65h loads A=IRAM[62h], DPTR=716Ch and calls 5314h
tables.output: ACC complement bit 7 then upper IRAM CCh; guarded path through C8h, R2 and RAM69h changes modeled P5 timing in G; physical output identity unknown
tables.static_evidence: 3C65h direct DPTR=716Ch and 5314h/532Fh/5333h MOVC path
tables.dynamic_evidence: Corrected C517A ADDATL model, experiments_adc517a: ADC2 100->40 moves MOVC pair 716Fh/7170h to 716Dh/716Eh in both G and S88; 11 reads per pair in each 2.4M-tick run. The downstream read at 398Dh was not executed in any of 18 grid runs. Optional air_716c_gate traces in G show PSW.5=0 at 3CDAh and the 3CE2h->3D0Bh->3D0Ch path for ADC3=80/4; upper IRAM CCh reaches 05h but 398Dh is still bypassed. Isolated original-opcode execution in all six ROMs with B=10h and CCh=05h writes C8h=10h when 2Fh.2=0 and AEh=40h, but writes 15h when 2Fh.2=1 or AEh=60h; changing CCh to 00h under an open guard restores C8h=10h. ROM[7349h]=5Eh in all six. This confirms a conditional CCh-to-C8h consumer, not natural reachability or a CC3 effect.
tables.full_boot_consumer_evidence: G original at 1000 RPM, ADC0/6=180/247 and ADC3/5/7=40/40/63, with default P4.6, reaches 11A8h and 398Dh. In 2.4M ticks, the air-gate probe records 169 visits to 398Dh before its 3000-event cap; 2Eh.6 is set and R2<IRAM6Fh in 341 visits to 3CB7h. MOVC 532Fh reads original 716Fh=86h 11 times and MOVC 5333h reads 7170h=80h 11 times. Supplying 8Eh only to MOVC 532Fh at 716Fh changes the dominant upper IRAM CCh/C8h state at 398Dh from 05h/05h to 0Ch/0Ch; at 39F4h before MOV R2,A, A changes A2h->A9h while prior R2 stays 9Dh. Raw ROM reads and the firmware SHA-256 remain unchanged. Modeled CC3 low-width median remains 4593 ticks in both runs. The modeled P5 timing effect and RAM69h mediation are recorded separately. Test: VariantTraceTests.test_air_lookup_716f_changes_p5_through_ram69_in_full_fiat_boot.
tables.full_boot_output_effect: In the same G 1000-RPM ADC0/6=180/247 state, supplying 8Eh at MOVC 532Fh/716Fh changes RAM69h A2h->A5h at 3B06h, last RAM34h A8h->34h at 051Ch and modeled P5.0/P5.1 median low widths 1861->1921 ticks over 36 pulses per channel; period stays 59400 ticks. CC3 median stays 4593. With the altered MOVC result, forcing RAM69h=A2h at its first 043Bh read restores P5 to 1861; with original MOVC, forcing RAM69h=A5h raises P5 to 1921. Native writes to 69h remain A5h and A2h respectively. This isolates RAM69h as the emulated mediator; physical coil connection and ADC2 sensor identity remain unverified.
tables.rpm_repeat_effect: G original with the same ADC inputs at 750/1000/1500 RPM reads 716Fh 11 times per 2.4M-tick run and reaches 398Dh. Supplying 8Eh instead of original 86h only at MOVC 532Fh/716Fh changes modeled P5.0/P5.1 median low widths 1860->1940 (28 pulses, period 79200), 1861->1921 (36, 59400), and 1767->1805 ticks (56, 39600). CC3 medians remain 4641, 4593 and 5137 ticks within each pair. RAM69h first 3B06h write changes A2h->A5h; 1500-RPM later writes are A1h/A4h. These are emulated timing effects, not physical time or confirmed coil identity.
tables.shared_cap_interaction: At G 1000 RPM and ADC0/6=180/247, supplying 8Eh only at MOVC 716Fh adds 07h to upper IRAM8Ch; donating S88's 120 bytes at 7CAEh adds 08h; both interventions add 0Fh before the cap. Dominant upper IRAM8Ch values at 3B06h are A2h/A9h/AAh/B1h for control/716Fh/S88-matrix/both. With 2Bh.4=0, original G opcodes 3AF1h..3B06h write RAM69h=min(upper IRAM8Ch,ROM[72A7h]=A5h), giving A2h/A5h/A5h/A5h. Modeled P5.0/P5.1 low-width medians are 1861/1921/1921/1921 ticks. All six ROMs have 72A7h=A5h; this branch was observed in the G emulator only.
tables.rpm1500_factorial: With the same ADC inputs at 1500 RPM, control/716Fh/S88-7CAEh/both give dominant upper IRAM8Ch 9Ch/A3h/A4h/ABh, RAM69h 9Ch/A3h/A4h/A5h and modeled P5.0/P5.1 low-width medians 1767/1805/1766/1805 ticks. Only the combined internal value exceeds the A5h cap; the S88 matrix alone is not capped yet has a -1-tick P5 effect. The new structured P5.0 histogram shows 52/56 low widths at 1767 ticks in control versus 50/56 at 1766 with S88 matrix; first 775/815-tick pulses are transients. CC3 median remains 5137 ticks. Thus the cap alone does not explain timing response across RPM.
tables.rpm2000_factorial: At 2000 RPM with raw ADC0/3/5/6/7=180/40/40/247/63 and 2.4M ticks, G control/716Fh-to-8Eh/S88-7CAEh/both have 11 reads of 716Fh and 912 reads of 7CAEh..7D25h each. Dominant upper IRAM8Ch and final RAM69h are 92h/99h/9Ah/A1h, all below the shared A5h cap. Modeled P5.0 low-width medians are 1805/1834/1805/1832 ticks; modeled CC3 medians 5173/5172/5173/5172. Thus the matrix changes RAM69h without changing P5 median by itself, but changes the combined response by -2 ticks relative to 716Fh alone. The physical output and mechanism of this small timing interaction remain unverified. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/air716f_7cae_rpm2000/; automated factorial test covers this state.
tables.rpm2000_ram69_mediation: With G ROM intact, 2000 RPM and 716Fh-to-8Eh supplied in all four runs, S88-7CAEh donor changes native RAM69h 99h->A1h, final Timer1 reload RAM34h:35h 9AFFh->A8FFh and modeled P5.0/P5.1 low median 1834->1832 ticks. Supplying A1h only at the 043Bh RAM69h read without matrix reproduces A8FFh and 1832; supplying 99h at that read with matrix restores 9AFFh and 1834. Native 3B06h writes remain 99h/A1h respectively. tables.rpm2000_timer1_path: Optional G Timer1 trace in the same four interventions records 299 loads at 0286h/0298h per run, with a 0298h load inside every one of 75 paired modeled P5.0 low intervals. tables.timer1_probe_1500: Optional Fiat G pre-tick trace at 1500 RPM, with the same ADC values, recorded 111 executions each of 0286h and 0298h in 2.4M ticks for both control and S88-7CAEh donor cases. Last stable IRAM32h:33h/34h:35h pairs were C5FFh/F1FEh in control and D9FFh/04FFh with donor. At 0286h the ROM loads TL1/TH1 from 34h/35h; at 0298h it loads from 32h/33h. Why the first interval shifts still requires IEX3 timing analysis. Physical output identity is unknown. Capture: build/ma17-analysis/variants/timer1_7cae_path/.
